nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit these three values. apiBase is where `uv run automation.py` listens (use http://host.docker.internal:7890/api/v1 when n8n runs in Docker on the same machine). csvPath is a file n8n can read; swap this node and the next two for a Google Sheets, Airtable or HubSpot node if the leads live there.

nodes.name: CSV rows
nodes.notes: One item per row, with the file's own column names. The API maps them the way `campaign.py import` does: First Name / first_name / FirstName, Surname, Mobile, Phone… Unknown columns are kept in custom_data.

nodes.name: POST /prospects/import
nodes.notes: Re-running is safe: the same rows create nothing new and add nobody twice. The Idempotency-Key makes a retry of this exact request return the stored answer. The answer carries created / duplicates / rejected (with the reason per row), prospect_ids, and the campaign.

nodes.name: POST /campaigns/{id}/start
nodes.notes: Makes the campaign ACTIVE (already ACTIVE answers changed: false). Nothing dials here: `uv run campaign.py run` — the scheduler — places the calls under calling hours, concurrency and pacing.
